spans.s:
ind.
Also, indeed.
E.
अपि, and उत or.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
1 Watery, consisting of water, as froth, &c.
2 Obtainable, to be obtained.
n. (-प्यं)
A plant, a kind of costus.
E.
अप water, यञ् affix; or आप to get, यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Stout, robust.
2 Fat.
E.
आङ् before स्फाय to grow, क्त aff.

Corpulency, growing or being fat or stout.
E.
आङ् before स्फाय to increase, ल्युट् aff.

Increased, improved.
4 Stout, fat.
E.
आङ् before स्फाय to increase, क्त aff.
